subject: Storix — Post-demo: hosted quickstart questions & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@storix.ai>, Chris Soto <chris.soto@storix.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Storix — Post-demo: hosted quickstart questions & next steps

Hi Lina / Chris,

Great to meet you both on the demo earlier — thanks for walking through the Storix use case. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can scope the right pilot:

What we heard
- Primary ask: real-time product recommendation/assistant for web + mobile (user-facing).
- Preference: minimize ops overhead initially; leaning toward Hosted API but want to understand limitations and transition path to Dedicated/VPC if needed.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required, possibility of PII-equivalent data (pseudonymized user ids).

A few items we need to confirm to propose the right hosted configuration and rate plan:
1) Traffic profile — typical sustained qps and realistic peak (minute-level bursts). You mentioned an estimate on the call; can you confirm numbers (avg qps, 95th/peak qpm)?
2) Latency SLO — you said ~200ms p95 target; confirm whether 300ms is acceptable for initial pilot.
3) Data residency — is leaving data in our US-hosted environment acceptable for pilot, or do you require a VPC/on-prem proof-of-concept up front?
4) Integrations — any files or attachment formats the model must access (uploads, user docs)?

Recommended quick path
- Hosted quickstart: sandbox access + one chat endpoint + one embeddings endpoint to start.
- Sandbox rate slice: 20 rps initially for integration tests, can be bumped to 50 rps during the pilot.
- Pilot: 6-week pilot with a 500 rps pilot slice and monitoring/tracing enabled; can transition to Dedicated or Private if we hit sustained requirements beyond hosted policies.

I attached a short quickstart playbook and a sample infra diagram so your ops team can eyeball network flows.

Next steps
- Lina/Chris: confirm the numbers for traffic and latency above.
- I’ll provision sandbox access and a proposed endpoint mapping (chat + embed) once we confirm.
- If you want, we can schedule a 30-min preflight with our solutions engineer (Monica) to discuss tokens/payloads and KV-cache expectations.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-quickstart-playbook.pdf (PDF, 240KB)], [Attachment: storix-network-diagram.png (PNG, 85KB)]

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lina Park <lina@storix.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Soto <chris.soto@storix.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Storix — Post-demo: hosted quickstart questions & next steps

Thanks Karthik — useful recap. Answers below inline.

Traffic profile
- Typical steady-state: ~800 requests/min (≈13 rps).
- Peak: ~2,500 requests/min (≈42 rps) during marketing spikes; short bursts up to ~100 rps for <2 minutes.

Latency
- Target: p95 < 200ms is ideal. For pilot, 300ms p95 is acceptable as long as it’s clearly measured and we get alerts on regressions.

Data residency & compliance
- Pilot: US-hosted is fine.
- Production: we may need VPC (private) for specific enterprise customers in EU later — want to understand migration path.

Integrations
- We will feed text payloads + small product images (base64) occasionally (rare). No large file storage required during pilot.

Timeline
- Aim to start pilot in ~6 weeks. We’ll need sandbox access this week for front-end integration testing.

Attaching a short infra summary so you can see our edge/ingest points.

Attachment: [Attachment: storix-infra-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Lina Park
Head of Product — Storix
lina@storix.ai

Date: Sun, 13 Apr 2025 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Storix — Post-demo: hosted quickstart questions & next steps

Thanks Lina — that helps a lot. Based on your profile I recommend we start with Hosted and the quickstart flow, with a clear migration path to VPC/Dedicated if you hit sustained production thresholds. Concrete proposal below: 

Proposal (Hosted quickstart -> pilot -> path to private)
- Sandbox (this week): 20 rps slice (shared test pool) — sandbox URL and temp API key below. Intended for integration and front-end testing only.
- Pilot (6-week): 50 rps dedicated slice with monitoring and tracing, auto-fallback policies enabled. This covers typical steady-state and the 42 rps peak with headroom for short bursts. If you hit sustained >80 rps for multiple hours/day we’ll recommend Dedicated.
- Production ramp: 150 rps+ reserved (Dedicated) or Private VPC depending on SLA and data residency needs.

Endpoint mapping suggestion
- /v1/chat (single chat endpoint): handles user-facing assistant.
- /v1/embeddings: vector store writes for search/relevance flows.

Rate limits & observability
- Sandbox: token-based limits — 300k tokens/min.
- Pilot: 1.2M tokens/min (equivalent to ~50 rps for your average payload). We’ll provide per-route token breakdowns in the console.

Sandbox access (provisioned)
- URL: https://sandbox.redwood.example.com/session/guest-xyz
- API key (temp): redwood-sbx-guest-XXXX (I’ll send the key in a separate, secure message)

Next steps
1) Monica — could you join a 30-min preflight next Tue to map payload sizes and confirm KV/cache behavior?
2) Marissa — I’ll need a pilot quote to validate the rate slices above.
3) Lina/Chris — confirm you want the sandbox key and we’ll lock a preflight on Tue.

References: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

Attachments included earlier: redwood-quickstart-playbook.pdf, storix-network-diagram.png

—
Karthik
